source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "municipal finance" OR "municipal fiscal" OR "local government finance" OR "municipal bonds" OR "property tax" AND municipal
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"municipal finance" OR "municipal fiscal" OR "local government finance" OR "municipal bonds" OR "property tax" AND municipal,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("local government finance" OR "municipal bonds" OR "municipal finance" OR "municipal fiscal" OR ("property tax" AND "municipal"))
